label: ⏳ Time-series Pro
description: Stationarity tests, ACF/PACF lag analysis, changepoint detection, rolling-window anomaly flagging, median-based outlier replacement, and three time-series visualizations: candlestick (OHLC), stream graph (center-baselined stacked area), horizon chart (compact small-multiples). Pairs with the built-in forecast, rolling, resample, and seasonal_decompose for a complete time-series toolkit.
author: DataInsightGrove
